text: PDF Viewer incorrectly intercepts Tab Search shortcut key on Mac

Chrome Version: 118 Stable
OS: macOS

What steps will reproduce the problem?
(1) Load a PDF
(2) Press Cmd+Shift+A

What is the expected result?

The browser's Search Tabs dialog opens

What happens instead?

The PDF Viewer performs a Select All.

The PDF Viewer should only select all the text when Cmd+A is pressed, and not do so when there are additional key modifiers.

PDF Viewer: Perform Select All only in response to Ctrl+A

Currently, the PDF Viewer looks for "Ctrl" and "A' to determine if it
should perform a Select All command, where "Ctrl" is "Cmd" on macOS.
This will also incorrectly match other key combinations, like
Ctrl+Shift+A, which is the keyboard shortcut for Tab Search.

Fix this by adding a hasCtrlModifierOnly() utility function and using
that instead of the existing hasCtrlModifier() function. Audit other "A"
key handling in PDF Viewer code and consistently use
hasCtrlModifierOnly().
Since the fix is relatively straight-forward, let's try to get this fixed out to our power users sooner rather than later.

re: https://crbug.com/chromium/1498522#c6 - Step 1 (Load a PDF) means open a PDF file, not open Print Preview.
If the Search Tabs dialog opened up blank in an unexpected fashion, then please file a separate bug report.

PDF Viewer: Add more tests for Select All behavior

Expand basic_plugin_test.ts with more test cases to test that:
- The initial state has no text selection.
- Select All via Ctrl+A (or macOS equivalent) works.
- All other combinations of modifiers+A do not Select All.

To make the tests work across platforms, change the build rules for
//chrome/test/data/pdf to do pre-processing using build_webui_tests().
Then the tests that use key events can choose Ctrl/Meta appropriately
depending on the platform.

To make build_webui_tests() work outside of //chrome/test/data/webui,
change its template definition to allow custom resource_path_prefix
values.

Along the way, switch the existing Select All tests to use Promises.
